property_summary: For any short order (isLong == false), fillOrder must record the expiration only under the taker's opposite-order id and must leave positionExpirations at the maker's order hash equal to 0; the mutant always writes it under the order hash, breaking this for any short order with duration > 0.
change_summary: Always record the expiration under the maker's orderHash instead of branching on order.isLong.
